page.notes: Right margin: the « marks are printed quotation marks running down the margin, transcribed at each line end. Line 14: "intercede" and "ret" are split without a printed hyphen, so written as "intercederet". Line 12: "facti rationem" is printed as one run; the space between "facti" and "rationem" is uncertain. Line 1: "ponere.Cornificius" lacks a space after the full stop as printed. Catchword "ua" completes "parua" from the next page.
